Definition
[normal exponential map]

Source: petersen:page-0206, petersen:page-0207 ↗ def:pet-ch5-exponential-map

Let $N\subset M$ be a properly embedded submanifold; its normal bundle is $T^\perp N=\{ v\in T_pM\mid p\in N,\ v\in (T_pN)^\perp \} $, so $T_pM=T_pN\oplus (T_pN)^\perp $ orthogonally for $p\in N$. The normal exponential map $\exp ^\perp :O\cap TN^\perp \to M$ restricts $\exp $ to $TN^\perp $.
